message:
♦️ FLEX GUI PRO V9.1.0 IS OFFICIALLY LIVE! (AFTER EFFECTS)

Version 9.1.0 introduces a massive overhaul to Map Rigs—transforming it into a full geographic storytelling engine—alongside true native Figma-to-AE vector pasting, a rebuilt Un-Precompose engine, and deep stability fixes across the entire extension.

*(Tip: Quit After Effects completely and reopen it after updating so the new build loads cleanly.)*

♦️ Map Rigs: Geographic Storytelling & Vector Drawing
* Direct Vector Drawing: Draw vector Areas, Lines, Points, Boxes, and Circles directly on your map with custom fills, dashed strokes, radius readouts in kilometers, and animated draw-on timings that stay locked to the terrain.
* Animated Story Routes & Pins: Build multi-stop travel routes that draw themselves on along straight lines or great circles with traveling markers, paired with anchored label pins and soft-edge territory focus dimming.
* Map Furniture & Data Choropleths: Add dynamic scale bars, coordinates, and counter-rotating compasses, or import CSV data to generate automated choropleth ramps and scaled data bubbles.
* 3D Interactive Globe: Switch from flat projection to an interactive 3D sphere with Latitude, Longitude, and Radius controls, customizable atmosphere glow, and space backgrounds.
* Custom GeoJSON/KML/GPX: Import external geospatial tracks directly into After Effects shape layers and pin markers.

♦️ Native Paste from Figma
* Lossless Vector Conversion: Copy as SVG from Figma and paste directly into Flex to generate native shape layers with original group names, masks, and clips preserved.
* Complex Style Translation: Retains multi-stop linear and radial gradients, drop/inner shadows, layer and background blurs, text fonts and weights, and embedded footage without flattening to raster approximations.

♦️ Rebuilt Un-Precompose Engine
* Lossless Geometry & Transform Parenting: Safely extracts nested layers while baking the precomp’s position, non-uniform scale, rotation, and opacity without destroying animated layer keyframes.
* Project Preservation: Source precomps are kept safe in a dedicated "Flex - Un-precomposed" bin rather than deleted, while time-stretched, 3D, or complex compositing precomps are safely preserved rather than corrupted.

♦️ Text Exploder, Properties & Proximity Fixes
* Safe Text Exploder: Refuses animated or expression-driven Source Text before splitting, resets duplicated unit transforms, and correctly handles tabs and unicode combining characters.
* Text Properties Precision: Fixed Tsume values sending 100x scales, corrected caps and leading setters, and paused auto-reads during typing or scrubbing.
* Resilient Proximity Rigs: Layer Control linking keeps Proximity expressions intact when controllers are renamed or reordered, supports separated X/Y/Z position dimensions, and preserves unrelated user expressions.
* Smart Python Discovery: AutoCaptions now auto-detects the specific Python environment containing Whisper across systems with multiple installations.
